name: Dune: Imperium - Uprising
summary:
After betraying and destroying House Atreides, the Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV has given House Harkonnen control over the planet Arrakis once more. But a mysterious warrior named Muad’Dib has risen to power among the Fremen, threatening the schemes of the Emperor and his allies.

This major expansion for Dune: Imperium Digital transforms the core experience with a new Imperium deck, reimagined conflicts, fresh leaders, and updated spaces to send your agents.

In Uprising, you want to continue to balance military might with political intrigue, wielding new tools in pursuit of victory. Spies will shore up your plans. Vital contracts will expand your resources. Or learn the ways of the Fremen and ride mighty sandworms into battle!
